claim: users.last_study_date / users.current_streak are stale after the SQL cutover, and AdminService dashboard still reads them
verdict: NOT REFUTED — claim holds on every material point; only the window sub-detail is slightly understated
severity_note: Real but bounded: the only live consumer is one admin-dashboard stat + a dead column. No user-facing, security, or data-integrity impact. MEDIUM is defensible; LOW is more accurate. The claim itself is not refuted.

no_writer_of_legacy_columns_in_main.grep: setLastStudyDate / setCurrentStreak / lastStudyDate assignments in src/main/java
no_writer_of_legacy_columns_in_main.result: 0 writers in src/main/java (only the @Column fields in User.java; only test fixtures set them)

no_trigger_no_computed_column.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys.triggers WHERE parent_id=OBJECT_ID('users'); SELECT name FROM sys.computed_columns WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID('users');
no_trigger_no_computed_column.note: So nothing keeps the legacy column in sync with study_days.

column_current_streak_is_dead.evidence: grep '\.getCurrentStreak()' in src/main/java matches only streakService.getCurrentStreak(...) (StudyActivityService-backed); User.getCurrentStreak() column getter has 0 readers
column_current_streak_is_dead.note: AdminUserDTO.currentStreak is populated from streakService, not the column

user_legacy_vs_study_days.sql: SELECT u.user_id,u.last_study_date,u.current_streak,(SELECT MAX(sd.study_date) FROM study_days sd WHERE sd.user_id=u.user_id) FROM users u ORDER BY u.user_id;
user_legacy_vs_study_days.note: Matches the claim exactly (user 2: 09-19 vs 09-22; user 3: 09-19 vs 09-21)

study_days_rows.sql: SELECT user_id,study_date FROM study_days WHERE user_id IN (2,3) ORDER BY user_id,study_date;
study_days_rows.consequence: truth currentStreak(user2)=2 (09-21,09-22 consecutive to today 09-22) while legacy users.current_streak=1

window_comparison_today_2026-09-22.sql: legacy: COUNT(*) users WHERE last_study_date > DATEADD(day,-N,today) | truth: COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) study_days WHERE study_date > DATEADD(day,-N,today)
window_comparison_today_2026-09-22.correction_to_claim: Claim said 3d -> '2 vs 2'. Measured 3d -> legacy 0 vs truth 2. Direction/divergence claim is right; that one sub-number is wrong. All other windows match the claim.

reproduced_live_http_facts.rate_limit_flush: docker exec engflow-redis redis-cli --scan --pattern 'rate_limit:*' then del each (done before the batch)

admin_stats.note: recentUsers=2 comes from the stale users.last_study_date (only users 2,3 have 2026-09-19 > 2026-09-15). No 429 produced.

admin_users_streak_for_user2.note: The per-row streak is CORRECT (2, from study_days) because it is served by streakService, not the users.current_streak column — this bounds the impact to the one aggregate stat.

legacy_query_callers.note: Confirmed by grep across src/ — the three finders are unreferenced in main source. Claim correct.

scheduler.conclusion: Reminder mail is unaffected by the stale column. Claim correct.

blast_radius_check.frontend: frontend/src/views/admin/AdminDashboard.vue:64 renders stats.recentUsers as 'Học trong 7 ngày' — the stale value is user-visible

answers_to_probe_questions.real_or_probe_artefact: Real. Two independent real DB reads (sqlcmd) plus a real HTTP 200 from the live admin endpoint. No 429 (rate-limit buckets flushed first). Not a scrollbar/guard artefact — this is a data-layer comparison.
answers_to_probe_questions.severity_justified: Partially. The defect is real but cosmetic/bounded (one admin stat + a dead column); no user-facing, security, or data-integrity impact. LOW is more accurate than MEDIUM, but the claim itself stands.
answers_to_probe_questions.correct_behaviour_or_bug: Bug / incomplete cutover. The new StudyActivityService.recordStudy path writes study_days only and never touches users.last_study_date, while AdminService still reads the legacy column. It is not an intentional design — the per-row streak was correctly migrated to streakService, showing the aggregate was simply missed.

verdict_reason: Every material assertion reproduced against the live system: AdminService.java:51 reads users.last_study_date; nothing in main source (or any trigger/computed column) writes it; users 2/3 have stale last_study_date (2026-09-19) vs study_days max (2026-09-22 / 2026-09-21); current_streak frozen at 1 vs truth 2; windowed divergence reproduced at 3d/2d/1d; the three legacy finders are unreferenced and the scheduler uses the study_days path; the live /api/admin/stats returns recentUsers=2 sourced from the stale column. Only the claim's '3d -> 2 vs 2' sub-number is wrong (measured 0 vs 2). Claim NOT REFUTED; severity corrected MEDIUM -> LOW.
